context: Yumiko and Sho do a quick home tidy.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (かける/置か/残さ/我が家/以内) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 十分以内に、片付けちゃいましょう。
lines.en: Let's tidy up within ten minutes.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: はーい!本は棚に置けばいい?
lines.en: Okay! Do I put the books on the shelf?
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうね、上着は椅子にかけてね。
lines.en: Yes, hang your jacket on the chair.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おもちゃ、全部置いたよ!
lines.en: I put away all the toys!
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ご飯を、残さず食べたわね。えらいわ。
lines.en: You ate without leaving any. Good job.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 我が家、ピカピカになったね!
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 時間以内に、終わったわね。
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: タオルも、かけておいたよ!
lines.en: I hung up the towels too!
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
